Authors: Jiaju Han, Xuemeng Sun, Qike Zhang, Xiang Chen, Luwei Yang, Jiahuan Long, Yiwei Wei, Jiujiang Guo, Chengyin Hu

Toward Integrating Adaptive Experience Replay and Online Uncertainty Estimation in Safe Actor-Critic Optimal Control RLRobot

safe actor-critic control barrier function uncertainty estimation experience replay robot navigation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种集成的安全演员-评论家架构，将不确定性估计、控制障碍函数和体验回放耦合，用于机器人导航，在极端噪声测试中展示了减少碰撞和更低信念误差的效果。

TLDR: The paper proposes an integrated safe actor-critic architecture that couples uncertainty estimation, control barrier functions, and experience replay for robot navigation, demonstrating reduced collisions and lower belief error in extreme noise tests.

Abstract: Safe actor-critic control often treats barrier filtering, uncertainty estimation, and experience replay as separate modules, even though each changes the data used for learning and control. We develop an integrated architecture in which the uncertainty estimate updates the obstacle geometry used by a control barrier function, filter interventions and estimation residuals determine replay priority, and the critic learns from the executed rather than nominal action. We instantiate the architecture on a two-dimensional robot-navigation task with corrupted obstacle measurements and compare six component-matched configurations under common training budgets, random seeds, sensor streams, exploration, and disturbances. Evaluation includes a moderate post-training test, an eleven-level perception-noise sweep, and an exploratory extreme-stress test at multiplier $6.0$. In the extreme test, the integrated configuration recorded no contacts and reached the goal in all five evaluation seeds. Its mean cost was $7.63\pm0.44$ and its obstacle-belief root-mean-square error was $3.52\pm0.55$ cm. The uncertainty-estimation ablation also recorded no contacts but reached the goal in four of five seeds, with mean cost $8.96\pm2.08$ and belief error $11.08\pm1.23$ cm. A finite-training bound clarifies replay exposure, and a robust barrier condition states the required estimation-error and feasibility assumptions. The results support coupling estimation, safety filtering, and replay on this benchmark; broader safety and convergence claims require further study.

摘要（中文）：安全演员-评论家控制通常将障碍滤波、不确定性估计和经验回放视为独立模块，尽管每个模块都会改变学习和控制所使用的数据。我们开发了一种集成架构，其中不确定性估计更新控制障碍函数所使用的障碍几何形状，滤波干预和估计残差决定回放优先级，且评论家从实际执行的行动而非名义行动中学习。我们在一个含有噪声障碍测量的二维机器人导航任务上实例化了该架构，并在共同训练预算、随机种子、传感器数据流、探索和干扰条件下比较了六种组件匹配的配置。评估包括中等强度训练后测试、十一级感知噪声扫描以及乘数$6.0$下的探索性极端压力测试。在极端测试中，集成配置在所有五个评估种子中均未发生接触并到达目标，其平均成本为$7.63\pm0.44$，障碍信念均方根误差为$3.52\pm0.55$厘米。不确定性估计消融实验也未发生接触，但在五个种子中有四个到达目标，平均成本为$8.96\pm2.08$，信念误差为$11.08\pm1.23$厘米。一个有限训练界限阐明了回放暴露问题，一个鲁棒障碍条件陈述了所需的估计误差和可行性假设。结果支持在该基准上将估计、安全滤波和回放进行耦合；更广泛的安全性和收敛性声明需要进一步研究。

Authors: Mahshad Rastegarmoghaddam, Davoud Nikkhouy, Shima Samadzadeh

Differential 6-DOF Pose Estimation with Provable First-Order Immunity to Camera Calibration Errors Perception3D

6-DOF motion estimation differential pose estimation camera calibration errors micromotion SE(3) PnP

简要说明：本文提出了一种差分六自由度位姿估计方法，通过帧间图像位移直接恢复平台运动，在微运动场景下实现了对相机外参标定误差的鲁棒性，并达到最先进的精度，适用于机器人操作和自主系统。

TLDR: This paper proposes a differential 6-DOF pose estimation method that directly recovers platform motion from inter-frame image displacements, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness to extrinsic calibration errors for micromotion, with applications in robotic manipulation and autonomous systems.

Abstract: Accurate six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion estimation is essential for robotic manipulation, autonomous systems, and structural displacement monitoring. Conventional 3D-2D methods estimate absolute camera poses independently at each time and recover platform motion through camera-to-platform extrinsics, making them sensitive to extrinsic calibration errors, especially for micromotion. We present a differential pose estimation method that directly recovers platform motion from inter-frame image displacements and known 3D control points. By differencing perspective projection equations, using a depth-invariance approximation, and modeling motion on SE(3), the method avoids independent absolute-pose estimation and supports both monocular and multi-camera systems. We prove that translational extrinsic errors cancel exactly, while rotational errors induce a bounded perturbation determined by calibration error, motion magnitude, and observation geometry. We also derive generic observability conditions, a Cramer-Rao lower bound, and a bias-eliminated consistent estimator, and characterize the validity limits of the approximations. Extensive synthetic and real-world experiments establish a new state of the art for 6-DOF platform micromotion estimation, outperforming representative PnP and generalized-PnP methods in accuracy, calibration robustness, and computational efficiency. With five control points and 0.5-pixel image noise, the monocular solver obtains a combined pitch-yaw rotation RMSE of 10.09 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.70 mm, and a runtime of 0.34 ms. The binocular solver achieves a rotation RMSE of 10.58 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.91 mm, and a runtime of 0.27 ms. Code will be released upon publication at https://github.com/zyoungszu/pami2026.

摘要（中文）：精确的六自由度运动估计对于机器人操控、自主系统及结构位移监测至关重要。传统的3D-2D方法独立估计每个时刻的绝对相机位姿，并通过相机到平台的标定参数恢复平台运动，这使得其对标定误差（尤其是微运动情况下的误差）非常敏感。本文提出一种差分位姿估计方法，直接从帧间图像位移和已知的3D控制点恢复平台运动。通过微分透视投影方程、采用深度不变性近似以及在SE(3)上建模运动，该方法避免了独立的绝对位姿估计，并同时支持单目和多相机系统。我们证明了平移外参误差会被完全抵消，而旋转误差仅产生一个由标定误差、运动幅度和观测几何决定的有限扰动。此外，我们推导了通用可观测性条件、克拉美-罗下界以及一种消除偏差的一致性估计器，并刻画了近似方法的有效极限。大量仿真与真实世界实验为六自由度平台微运动估计建立了新的最优水平，在精度、标定鲁棒性和计算效率方面均优于代表性的PnP和广义PnP方法。使用五个控制点和0.5像素图像噪声时，单目求解器在俯仰-偏航联合旋转上的均方根误差为10.09角秒，平移均方根误差为3.70毫米，运行时间为0.34毫秒；双目求解器的旋转均方根误差为10.58角秒，平移均方根误差为3.91毫米，运行时间为0.27毫秒。代码将于论文发表后公开在 https://github.com/zyoungszu/pami2026。

Authors: Yueqiang Zhang, Liang Deng, Yi Zhang, Baoqiong Wang, Wenjun Chen, Shuixin Pan, Yulan Guo, Qifeng Yu

Structured LLM Reasoning for Zero-Shot Human--Robot Coordination Under Hidden Goals Other

LLM reasoning Theory-of-Mind human-robot coordination Dec-POMDP

简要说明：提出一种结构化大语言模型架构，将决策分解用于存在隐藏目标的协作建筑任务中的零样本人机协调，在效率和信任度上优于基线方法。

TLDR: A structured LLM architecture decomposes decision-making for zero-shot human-robot coordination in a cooperative construction task with hidden goals, outperforming baselines in efficiency and trust.

Abstract: We present a structured large-language-model (LLM) architecture for zero-shot human--robot coordination in a cooperative construction task with private goal views. Guided by a Dec-POMDP formulation, the architecture decomposes decision-making into (i) action-conditioned Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference, (ii) hierarchical planning, (iii) conversation interpretation, (iv) action verification, and (v) feedback-based replanning. We compare the proposed method with an ablation without ToM inference and a multi-agent reinforcement-learning policy trained offline over many goal pairs. In human-participant experiments, the proposed method required fewer interaction steps and yielded higher post-interaction trust ratings than both baselines. These results suggest that systematically decomposing the team decision problem, using LLMs as tractable surrogates for otherwise intractable inference and planning computations, and retaining conventional verification for physical feasibility can improve both task coordination and the human experience.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种结构化的大语言模型架构，用于在具有私有目标视图的协作建造任务中实现零样本的人机协调。在去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）框架的指导下，该架构将决策分解为：(i) 基于动作的心理理论（ToM）推理、(ii) 分层规划、(iii) 对话解析、(iv) 动作验证，以及 (v) 基于反馈的重新规划。我们将所提方法与不含ToM推理的消融模型以及一个在多个目标对上进行离线训练的多智能体强化学习策略进行了比较。在人类参与实验中，所提方法相较于两种基线方法，所需的交互步骤更少，并且带来了更高的交互后信任评分。这些结果表明，系统性地分解团队决策问题、利用大语言模型作为原本难以处理的推理与规划计算的可处理替代方案，同时保留针对物理可行性的传统验证方法，能够同时改善任务协调性与人类体验。

Authors: Dong Hae Mangalindan, Anand Gokhale, Francesco Bullo, Vaibhav Srivastava

SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding Perception3D

dynamic modality orchestration 3D scene understanding semantic-guided routing modality-aware gating multimodal large language models

简要说明：SmartMage 提出了一种动态模态路由与门控机制，用于三维场景理解，通过选择查询相关的视觉和几何模态，在多个基准上取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: SmartMage introduces a dynamic modality routing and gating mechanism for 3D scene understanding, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks by selecting query-relevant visual and geometric modalities.

Abstract: Understanding 3D scenes is fundamental to embodied intelligence, requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including visual and geometric cues. However, the relevance of these modalities often varies across queries. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically rely on fixed modality combinations, overlooking query-dependent modality needs. Such a rigid design can introduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while underutilizing more informative ones, leading to wasted computation and diluted reasoning. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SmartMage, a unified MLLM that dynamically orchestrates heterogeneous modalities for semantic-aware 3D scene understanding. Specifically, SmartMage incorporates: (1) a Semantic-guided Modality Adaptive RouTng (SMART) module that selects task-relevant modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality; and (2) a Modality-Aware Gating Expert (MAGE) module that leverages modality priors to guide expert activation, fostering adaptive specialization in multimodal reasoning. Empirically, SmartMage achieves state-of-the-art performance across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks, and attains competitive results on RGB-only video understanding benchmarks. In our diagnostic benchmark ScanFacet, tasks are divided into fine-grained semantic categories, enabling analysis of modality combinations preferred by each semantic type. The observed modality-semantic patterns provide further evidence of SmartMage's effectiveness. Project page: https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/.

摘要（中文）：理解三维场景是具身智能的基础，需要联合推理来自多种模态（包括视觉与几何线索）的异质信息。然而，这些模态的相关性常因查询而异。现有的大规模多模态语言模型通常依赖固定模态组合，忽略了查询相关的模态需求。这种刚性设计不仅会引入无关模态的语义噪声，还会弱化信息量更丰富的模态，导致计算浪费与推理深度不足。为应对这些挑战，本文提出SmartMage——一种统一的多模态大语言模型，能够动态编排异质模态，实现语义感知的三维场景理解。具体而言，SmartMage包含：(1) 语义引导的模态自适应路由模块，利用语义先验、文本-模态对齐及模态质量选择任务相关模态；(2) 模态感知门控专家模块，借助模态先验引导专家激活，促进多模态推理中的自适应特化。实验表明，SmartMage在五个三维场景理解基准上取得最先进性能，并在纯RGB视频理解基准上达到具有竞争力的结果。在我们的诊断基准ScanFacet中，任务被划分为细粒度语义类别，可分析各语义类型偏好的模态组合。所观测到的模态-语义模式进一步证明了SmartMage的有效性。项目主页：https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/。
